back.name: Back
back.description: Lats, traps and rhomboids for a strong, upright posture.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.description: Brace one hand on a bench and pull the dumbbell to your hip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.description: Lie across a bench and lower one dumbbell behind your head with straight arms.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.description: Hinge at the hips with a flat back and row the bar to your lower ribs.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: Lift the bar from the floor by driving through your legs and keeping your back flat.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.description: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull your chin over it.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.description: Hang under a low bar with straight legs and pull your chest to the bar.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.description: Hinge and snap your hips forward to swing the bell to chest height.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Gorilla Row
exercises.description: In a wide hinge, row one of two kettlebells while the other stays on the floor.

chest.name: Chest
chest.description: Pectorals for pushing strength and upper-body size.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Lie on a flat bench and press two dumbbells up over your chest.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
exercises.description: On an incline bench, open your arms wide in an arc, then squeeze them back together.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Lower the bar to mid-chest under control and press it back up.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Bench press on a 30-45 degree incline to target the upper chest.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: Keep a straight line from head to heels and lower your chest to the floor.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.description: On parallel bars, lean forward slightly and lower until your shoulders are below your elbows.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Floor Press
exercises.description: Lie on the floor and press two kettlebells up until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Squeeze Press
exercises.description: Press one kettlebell held by the horns while squeezing it hard with both hands.

legs.name: Legs
legs.description: Quads, hamstrings, glutes and calves - your biggest muscles.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at your sides and step forward into alternating lunges.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: With soft knees, push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.description: With the bar on your upper back, squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.description: With your upper back on a bench, drive the bar up with your hips and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.description: Squat down with your chest up and weight in your heels, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.description: Rest your back foot on a bench and lower your back knee toward the floor.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
exercises.description: Hold the kettlebell at your chest and squat between your knees.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
exercises.description: Hinge to grab the kettlebell between your feet and stand up tall.

biceps.name: Biceps
biceps.description: Front of the upper arm, used for pulling and curling.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the dumbbells to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: Curl with your palms facing each other to work the biceps and forearms.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.description: Curl the bar with an underhand grip without swinging your body.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Curl
exercises.description: Curl the bar with an overhand grip to build the forearms and brachialis.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.description: Hang with an underhand, shoulder-width grip and pull your chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Isometric Towel Curl
exercises.description: Stand on a towel and curl the ends upward as hard as you can without moving.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Curl
exercises.description: Hold the kettlebell by the handle and curl it to your chest.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Hammer Curl
exercises.description: Hold the kettlebell handle with a neutral grip and curl one arm at a time.

triceps.name: Triceps
triceps.description: Back of the upper arm, used for pressing and straightening the elbow.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Extension
exercises.description: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands and lower it behind your head.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Kickback
exercises.description: Hinge forward and straighten your arm behind you, keeping the elbow still.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Bench press with your hands shoulder-width apart and elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Barbell Skull Crusher
exercises.description: Lying on a bench, bend only at the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.description: With your hands on a bench behind you, bend your elbows to lower your hips.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.description: Do a push-up with your hands together under your chest forming a diamond.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Overhead Extension
exercises.description: Hold the kettlebell by the horns overhead and lower it behind your head.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Close-Grip Floor Press
exercises.description: On the floor, press one kettlebell held by the horns with elbows tucked in.

abdominals.name: Abdominals
abdominals.description: Core muscles that stabilize your spine in every lift.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
exercises.description: Sit leaning back with feet raised and rotate a dumbbell side to side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and bend sideways, then return upright.

exercises.name: Barbell Rollout
exercises.description: From your knees, roll a loaded barbell forward and pull it back with your abs.

exercises.name: Landmine Rotation
exercises.description: With one end of the bar anchored, rotate the other end from hip to hip.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms and toes.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: Hang from a bar and raise your legs without swinging.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.description: Bring opposite elbow to opposite knee while pedaling your legs.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up
exercises.description: Hold a kettlebell overhead and move from lying down to standing, then reverse.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Windmill
exercises.description: With the bell overhead, hinge sideways and reach your free hand toward your foot.

shoulders.name: Shoulders
shoulders.description: Deltoids for overhead strength and healthy shoulder joints.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Seated or standing, press two dumbbells from your shoulders to overhead.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Raise the dumbbells out to your sides until they reach shoulder height.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.description: Standing, press the bar from your collarbone to straight overhead.

exercises.name: Barbell Upright Row
exercises.description: Pull the bar up along your body to chest height, leading with your elbows.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.description: With your hips high in an upside-down V, lower your head toward the floor.

exercises.name: Wall Walk
exercises.description: From a push-up position, walk your feet up a wall and your hands toward it.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halo
exercises.description: Hold the kettlebell upside down and circle it slowly around your head.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Press
exercises.description: Press a kettlebell held upside down, keeping it balanced the whole way.
